trigger.description: An operator runs `ee share preview --peer <peer>` for a peer that has no resolvable outbound mesh policy (no matching [[mesh.peer_policies]] entry for the local workspace, peer id, and origin workspace, or an ambiguous match). Peer resolution fails closed, so every lane denies and nothing would be shared; the preview surfaces the peer as unconfigured rather than showing a misleading allow.
setup_commands: seed a memory but do NOT add a [[mesh.peer_policies]] entry for the target peer in .ee/config.toml
